sources.quote: shall be open to inspection by the Special Committee Investigating the Munitions Industry, United States Senate

rationale: One clause: authorization of inspection of tax returns by the Senate committee, subject to Treasury rules. Its subject is the committee authorized by Senate Resolution 206. No held text shows the committee's termination, performance or any revocation; EO 7039 is an additional authorization (different returns) and is not shown to supersede 6742. An authorization that is not shown to have been used or ended cannot be recorded as ended by assumption. Research-only proposal; text is a working text, original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Source showing when the Special Committee (S. Res. 206, 73d Cong.) ceased to exist or finished inspection, or a later revoking order.
